title: Penkovsky papers: a Nazi psychic unit taken over by the Soviets
place_text: Germany; Soviet Union; Monterey, California (language school)

tellings.quote: And it said that um Adolf Hitler had had a unit called Dr. Grunbomb in Germany

plain: Russian-language reading material from a Soviet colonel named Igor Pinkovski said that Adolf Hitler had a psychic unit called "Dr. Grunbomb" in Germany, and that the Soviets later took it over. Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, says he read this in the 1960s while learning Russian at a language school in Monterey, California. If true, it would mean the Soviet psychic research of the Cold War grew out of a Nazi program.
